title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12689)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12689) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12689). This Indian Standard was adopted by the draft finalized by the Small Tools Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard has been prepared based on the prevalent practices in Indian industry and developments at international level. In the preparation of this standard , considerable assistance has been derived from DIN 8376 : 1981 Subland twist drills with parallel shank for clearance holei and counterbores for hexagon socket head cap screws and slotted cheese head screws issued by the Deustches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ). The other Indian Standards in this series are: Small tools — Subland drills with morse taper shanks for countersunk holes prior to tapping screw threads — Specification Small tools — Subland twist drills with morse taper shanks for clearance holes and countersinks for countersunk head screws prior to tapping screws thread — Specification Small tools — Subland twist drills with morse taper shanks for clearance hol
